title: ULTRA Arcane and Gears
description: An expert blend of industrial engineering and mystical wonders, featuring Create and The Twilight Forest for the ultimate magi-tech adventure.
body:
![Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c959ed46d3fb22d69e04e87e86d9b778990067c1.png)

This is a modpack focused on questing and machine development. If you are an experienced player, you might find the progression quite fast. As this is my very first modpack, I apologize for any shortcomings! I am not fluent in English, so this description and the in-game content have been translated by AI for communication purposes.

# ⚠️ Warning: Manual Installation Required!
The modpack you downloaded is incomplete. You MUST manually install the following mods for the pack and its quests to function properly:

FTB Series: (FTB Quests, FTB Teams, FTB Ultimine, FTB Library, FTB Xmod Compat)

The Twilight Forest

Why? Due to licensing and redistribution restrictions, I cannot include these files directly in the pack.

Note: All your quest progress and configurations for Create, Ad Astra, Farmer's Delight, and Coins are already included! Just drop the .jar files into your mods folder and you're ready to go!
